title: kb/_self/token-efficiency.md states what the multi-agent runs show
goal: kb/_self/token-efficiency.md gains a section Concurrent agents stating the conclusions the multi rows support on concurrency against the sequential baseline, coord dedup, prompt-cache reuse, Haiku against Sonnet and Opus per role, the pack budget and kb tools against reading files; each conclusion cites the section of the benchmarks report it rests on; it states per scenario what kb agents cost against bare agents with no kb tooling in tokens and USD per correct answer, per verified fact and per passing item, with the kb-minus-bare direction, from the report's comparison table

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import re
t = open("kb/_self/token-efficiency.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"^## Concurrent agents\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", t, re.S | re.M)
assert m, "no section Concurrent agents"
s = m.group(1)
for w in ("sequential baseline", "dedup", "cache", "Haiku", "pack budget", "reading files"):
    assert w in s, w
assert s.count("reports/benchmarks.md") >= 3, "the conclusions cite no report section"
